mr_title: Fix JSON logging excluded keys config ignoring nested fields

expected_issues.title: excludedKeys.contains(null) can throw for anonymous objects and arrays
expected_issues.description:
startObject/startArray call excludedKeys.contains(key) with a key that JBoss LogManager may pass as null (anonymous objects/arrays); with an immutable Set this throws NullPointerException and log records are lost.

The generator API allows a null key for unnamed structures. Sets created with Set.of()/Set.copyOf() throw NPE on contains(null), so enabling exclusion of nested keys makes JSON logging crash for records containing arrays or nested objects. The key must be null-checked before the lookup (in all four overrides).
